responsibility: VxWorks-specific crtbegin startup object for GNAT exception handling metadata registration. This file selects the plain variant of the shared vx_crtbegin implementation: it instantiates publicly visible constructor and destructor entry points that call __register_frame_info and __deregister_frame_info on the local .eh_frame anchor, but does not place them into any loader-specific section itself. Its role is to provide the bare registration/deregistration functions for configurations where some external VxWorks startup mechanism is responsible for invoking them.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is the concrete wrapper variant in the vx_crtbegin group: it differs from vx_crtbegin.inc by contributing only the per-variant policy macros (here empty CTOR_ATTRIBUTE and DTOR_ATTRIBUTE definitions) and then including the shared body, so it produces a plain compiled startup object with no special constructor/destructor attributes of its own.
